items.source: Execute the query with paging and convert the result set to a Slice of entities. A sliced query translates the effective fetch size to the page size.
items.translation: 执行带分页的查询，并将结果集转换为实体类的Slice。切片查询会将有效的fetch size转换为每页大小。
